name: siteborne-utility-network
description: SITEBORNE Utility Network - Machine-native utility network for autonomous agents

scripts.control-plane:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm control-plane:test
scripts.document-worker:fixtures:verify: cd services/modal-worker && .venv/bin/python -c "import json,pathlib; m=json.loads(pathlib.Path('fixtures/MANIFEST.json').read_text()); pdf=[f for f in m['pdf'] if not (pathlib.Path('fixtures/pdf')/f).exists()]; img=[f for f in m['images'] if not (pathlib.Path('fixtures/images')/f).exists()]; assert not pdf and not img, (pdf, img); print(f'fixture manifest OK: {len(m[\"pdf\"])} pdf + {len(m[\"images\"])} image fixtures present')"
scripts.document-worker:check: pnpm document-worker:lint && pnpm document-worker:typecheck && pnpm document-worker:test && pnpm document-worker:modal-import-check
scripts.adapters:check: pnpm --filter @siteborne/provider-adapters run format:check && pnpm --filter @siteborne/provider-adapters run lint && pnpm --filter @siteborne/provider-adapters run typecheck && pnpm --filter @siteborne/provider-adapters run all:test && pnpm --filter @siteborne/provider-adapters run test:property && pnpm adapters:fixtures:verify && pnpm adapters:manifests:verify
scripts.verification:check: pnpm --filter @siteborne/verification run format:check && pnpm --filter @siteborne/verification run lint && pnpm --filter @siteborne/verification run typecheck && pnpm verification:test && pnpm verification:test:property && pnpm verification:fixtures:verify && pnpm verification:policy:verify
scripts.services-runtime:check: pnpm --filter @siteborne/service-runtime run format:check && pnpm --filter @siteborne/service-runtime run lint && pnpm --filter @siteborne/service-runtime run typecheck && pnpm services-runtime:test && pnpm services-runtime:test:property && pnpm services-runtime:fixtures:verify
scripts.x402:check: pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-x402 run format:check && pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-x402 run lint && pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-x402 run typecheck && pnpm x402:test && pnpm x402:test:property && pnpm x402:fixtures:verify
scripts.mcp:test: pnpm mcp:test:protocol && pnpm mcp:test:edge && pnpm mcp:test:stdio
scripts.mcp:check: pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-mcp run check && pnpm mcp:test:edge && pnpm --filter @siteborne/mcp-server run check
scripts.nevermined:check: pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-nevermined run format:check && pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-nevermined run lint && pnpm --filter @siteborne/protocol-nevermined run typecheck && pnpm nevermined:test && pnpm nevermined:fixtures:verify && pnpm nevermined:spec:verify && pnpm nevermined:compat:verify
scripts.secrets:scan: pnpm secrets:scope:verify && gitleaks git . --config=.gitleaks.toml --redact --verbose && gitleaks dir . --config=.gitleaks.toml --redact --verbose
scripts.security:release: pnpm security:semgrep && pnpm security:osv && pnpm security:trivy
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm pcc:generate:check && pnpm services:generate:check && pnpm openapi:generate:check && pnpm python:test:pcc && pnpm python:test:modal && pnpm governance:validate && pnpm state:validate && pnpm tasks:validate && pnpm contracts:baseline:verify && pnpm contracts:compat:check && pnpm contracts:release:verify && pnpm migrations:verify && pnpm d1:test && pnpm control-plane:test && pnpm control-plane:check && pnpm adapters:check && pnpm document-worker:check && pnpm document-worker:fixtures:verify && pnpm verification:check && pnpm services-runtime:check && pnpm x402:check && pnpm mcp:check && pnpm a2a:check && pnpm nevermined:check && pnpm secrets:scan
